One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Before the stamp comes $68 in fees and a 17-day delay before the stamp dries, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The clerk notes island. The forge is checked, not assumed. saffron stays on the record.
